name: Denmark Open
stakes: This week is crucial for India's shuttlers to gain valuable ranking points and build momentum as the season progresses towards major championships.
summary:
India's campaign at the Denmark Open has faced a challenging start, with several key shuttlers making early exits. Women's Singles star PV Sindhu, who recently clinched the Japan Open title, bowed out in the opening round. Similarly, in Men's Singles, both Lakshya Sen and veteran HS Prannoy have exited the tournament, leaving only Kidambi Srikanth as the sole Indian male singles player still in contention.

Despite these setbacks, the nation's primary hopes now rest on the top-ranked Men's Doubles pair, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty. They are set to begin their challenge in the Round of 32 against He-Ren, aiming for a deep run in this Super 750 event. Women's Doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand, a promising duo, await their first-round opponents, hoping to continue their upward trajectory. Young talent Malvika Bansod in Women's Singles also awaits her R32 matchup. The early stages of the tournament have highlighted the intense competition, making every remaining match crucial for India's contingent.
